query: Moss Inference request search multiple indexes limit

text: A single Moss Inference request can search at most 32 indexes (same limit on moss/fastlane-1 and vendor models). That cap covers the indexes named in the X-Moss-Indexes header and in a moss_search tool together (moss_search takes 1 to 32 index names). Naming more than 32 returns a 400 invalid_request_error. To raise it, ask Support.
